description: Security descriptor for SAP BTP Enterprise CapEx Procurement Application

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ProcurementViewer
scopes.description: Read-only access to CapEx analytics, budgets, and request portfolio

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ProcurementManager
scopes.description: Departmental review and approval authorization for CapEx requests

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.ProcurementAdmin
scopes.description: Executive sign-off, S/4HANA destination sync, and system configuration

attributes.name: CostCenterDepartment
attributes.description: Assigned cost center department for authorization filtering

role-templates.name: ProcurementViewerTemplate
role-templates.description: Allows viewing CapEx dashboards and reports

role-templates.name: ProcurementManagerTemplate
role-templates.description: Allows department managers to review and approve submitted requests

role-templates.name: ProcurementAdminTemplate
role-templates.description: Provides full executive control, treasury release, and ERP sync rights

role-collections.name: CapEx_Viewer_Collection
role-collections.description: Standard business user with read-only access to CapEx records

role-collections.name: CapEx_Manager_Collection
role-collections.description: Departmental manager with review and approval authority

role-collections.name: CapEx_Admin_Collection
role-collections.description: Enterprise administrator with executive release privileges
